sloka: पश्चिमेन तु तं दृष्ट्वा सागरोद्गारसन्निभम् ।वर्धन्तमम्भसो वेगं पूर्वामाशां प्रविश्य तु ।। ७.३२.९ ॥
transliteration: paścimena tu taṁ dṛṣṭvā sāgarodgārasannibham ।vardhantamambhaso vegaṁ pūrvāmāśāṁ praviśya tu ।। 7.32.9 ॥

translations.english: Having seen that increasing current of water, resembling the gushing forth of the ocean, entering the eastern direction from the west.
